note: Every scenario passed against the current source before export (unit/dom: Vitest + jsdom; browser: Playwright + Chromium, production build). Tags "bug" pin current behaviour that the new library MUST fix — see 07-parity-and-bugs.md.

scenarios.title: Placement order
when: sort all items with the placement comparator
then: order is start time ascending, then level rank ascending (lower rank = stronger), then id (locale compare)
three items at the same start with levels watch(id b), watch(id a), critical(id z) sort as z, a, b
the list view and the timeline view use the same order
golden: golden/order-baseline.json

scenarios.title: Isolated items are full width
then: every item that overlaps nothing is in column 0 of 1 column

scenarios.title: Stronger levels take the left columns inside an overlap group
then: c01 (critical, 08:30) is column 0 of 3
golden: golden/layout-baseline-day-regular.json

scenarios.title: Column cap and overflow group
then: no overlap group uses more than 3 columns
overflowed items form at least one "+more" group
golden: golden/layout-crowded-regular.json (k06, k02, k03 placed; k04, k05, k01, k07 in one group anchored 09:00)

scenarios.title: Compact mode column cap
then: when more than 3 items overlap, at most 1 column is used
golden: golden/layout-crowded-compact.json

scenarios.title: Promotion from overflow
then: placed: critical, monitoring, watch
overflow: routine only

scenarios.title: Overflow buckets merge across hours
then: one overflow group anchored at 10:00 containing [d, e]

scenarios.title: Shared column count per overlap-connected group
then: every placed card of the 09:00–11:30 cluster reports the same column count
the isolated 14:00 item is column 0 of 1

scenarios.title: Geometry
when: compute the timeline layout with range start = previous shift start
then: top = (start − range start) in minutes × 172 / 60 px
height = max(duration px − 4, 80) px
missing end = start + 2 h
c09 (17:00, no end): top 3612, height 340
10-minute item: height 80
90 minutes = 258 px

scenarios.title: Large golden layouts are stable
when: compute regular and compact layouts twice
then: output equals golden/layout-large-regular.json, golden/layout-large-compact.json and golden/layout-baseline-day-compact.json
measured cost: ~290 ms per layout of 240 items (Node, jsdom run) — see perf budgets

scenarios.title: Shift windows
when: resolve the shift for several instants
then: 07:59:59 → night previous day 20:00 → 08:00
02:00 → night previous day 20:00 → 08:00
20:00 → night 20:00 → next day 08:00
previous and next of a day shift are night shifts; offset +2 is a day shift

scenarios.title: Bucketing items into shifts

given.extra: one item at next-day 08:00, one at 20:00

when: bucket items by start into previous/current/next
then: boundaries are half-open [start, end)
previous: p01–p04; current: c01–c10; next: n01–n03 plus the 20:00 item
items outside the three windows are dropped
NOTE: the source mutates ids to keep keys unique across shifts — the new core MUST NOT mutate ids

scenarios.title: DST: fixed-duration windows drift

given.timeZone: a zone with a spring-forward on 2031-03-30 at 03:00

then: current behaviour: night window 2031-03-29 20:00 → 2031-03-30 09:00 (wall clock); next window starts 09:00
this is bug B-07; the new core MUST anchor boundaries on wall-clock hours

scenarios.title: Label formats
when: format hour labels, boundary ranges, clock times, "since" timestamps, shift dates
then: hour labels always en-US compact: 12AM, 8AM, 12PM, 1PM, 8PM
boundary range (en): "Mar 11, 8 PM - Mar 12, 8 AM"; any language other than es falls back to en-US
non-finite boundary → empty string
clock time (en): "10:30 AM"
since timestamp: "03/12/2031 07:45 AM" (fixed US pattern)
shift date (en): "March 12, 2031"
golden: golden/format-samples.json (includes es output)

scenarios.title: Header expanded signal (injected layout)

given.layout: sticky 64 px, client 600, scroll 3000, previous 0, current 600, next 2200, header 60, current cards at 660 + i·110 (h 100)

then: 100 → true (previous in view)
536 → true (current header at the sticky edge)
1100 → false

878 → true, 879 → false: the collapse threshold is the bottom of the 3rd element matching the card selector + 8 px; hidden pin sentinels count as elements, so with a pinned-level first card the threshold is the 2nd card (bug B-08)
